name: Exsim Hospitality Berhad
summary: Exsim Hospitality Berhad, an investment holding company, operates in the hospitality industry in Malaysia. It operates through Own and Operate, Hospitality Operator, Fit-Out segments. The company owns and operates the Port Dickson hotel. It also owns and manages properties owned by third-party owners, including serviced residences and en bloc boutique hotels; and leases these properties out to guests for short-term stays under the Mana Mana Hospitality brand. In addition, the company provides interior design, renovation and fit-out services for hospitality assets, general contracting business, and centralised procurement business.
